attribute_descriptions.strength: Raises melee damage and improves the bonus from equipped weapons.
attribute_descriptions.agility: Improves firearm damage, hiding, fleeing, evasion, and firearm bonuses.
attribute_descriptions.intellect: Raises spell damage, healing, starting mana, mana gained on level up, and experience earned.
attribute_descriptions.vitality: Raises starting health, health gained on level up, armor effectiveness, and guarding.
